nhsn_hrd.name: NHSN Hospital Respiratory Data
nhsn_hrd.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nhsn_hrd.location: Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data (HRD) Metrics by Jurisdiction, National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN)
nhsn_hrd.description: Acute care and critical access hospitals report bed capacity, bed occupancy, and the number of patients and new admissions with COVID-19, influenza, and RSV to CDC's National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). CDC publishes weekly totals for the nation, HHS regions, states, and territories, starting in August 2020. Through the week ending October 5, 2024, bed and patient values are weekly averages of daily reports; from October 12, 2024, they are values for the Wednesday of the week. Admissions are weekly totals. Reporting was voluntary from May 1 to October 31, 2024, so far fewer hospitals are included in those weeks. RSV reporting was voluntary before November 1, 2024. Earlier weeks can change as hospitals submit late or corrected reports.
nhsn_hrd.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
